newsitem.title: UK: UK's Clarke says to phase out PRP tax relief.
newsitem.headline: UK's Clarke says to phase out PRP tax relief.

text.p: Britain's Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke said the upper limit for profit related pay (PRP) schemes will remain at 4,000 stg until 1998 and will then be progressively reduced until it is withdrawn in 2000.
"The goal of widespread use of PRP has been achieved and I would rather make faster progress on lower taxes for everybody," Clarke said in a speech to parliament on the 1997/98 budget.
He said over 3.7 million taxpayers were in PRP schemes but that the increasing cost of tax relief could no longer be justified.
